commit: PIN: 40-hex harness commit the reader runs from (clean checkout)

shippedBinary.sha256: PIN: sha256 of the exact shipped kaspad the drill nodes run

salt: PIN: the drill's 64-hex genesis salt (never a public value)

identity.genesis: PIN: 128-hex salted genesis hash the drill nodes report
identity.consensusParamsId: PIN: 64-hex consensus params id of the shipped release ruleset
identity.retirementPolicyId: PIN: 128-hex settlement policy id the release ruleset commits

nodes.name: seat0-archival
nodes.wrpc: PIN: 127.0.0.1:port of an ARCHIVAL drill node's wRPC JSON listener

nodes.name: seat1-archival
nodes.wrpc: PIN: 127.0.0.1:port of a second archival drill node

nodes.name: seat2
nodes.wrpc: PIN: 127.0.0.1:port of a pruning drill node

keyringManifest.sha256: PIN: sha256 of the manifest written by kaspad --palw-drill-write-keyring for this salt

window.observeAfterFenceDaa: PIN: >= legacySettlementWindowDaa, so every legacy settlement falls inside the scan
window.legacySettlementWindowDaa: PIN: epoch_length_blocks + reward_uniqueness_window_blocks + max_reorg_horizon_blocks of the shipped DnsParams (0 = the strict reading)

scan.maximumChainBlocks: PIN: bound on selected-chain blocks from genesis to the scan end
scan.maximumBlockReads: PIN: bound on block body reads (chain blocks and their mergesets)
scan.maximumStatusReads: PIN: bound on getStakeBonds pages (registry plus one point-of-view read per DAA with a DNS share)
scan.maximumBondPages: PIN: bound on registry pages per read

bounds.workflowTimeoutSeconds: PIN: wall-clock bound for the reader, from start until the chain passes the fence span
bounds.pollSeconds: PIN: polling interval while waiting for the fence
